description: This file implements the VoiceControl plugin class, handling voice session management, configuration, and event handling via IARM bus communication in a C++ project. It includes registration of methods, event handlers, and internal logic for voice session control.

classes.name: VoiceControl
classes.description: Main plugin class managing voice control sessions, event handling, and communication with control manager via IARM bus.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, sets up IARM event handlers, and retrieves PII masking setting.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources and removes event handlers.

methods.name: voiceEventHandler
methods.description: Static callback for IARM events, delegates to instance method.

methods.name: iarmEventHandler
methods.description: Handles specific IARM events related to voice sessions and streams.

methods.name: getApiVersionNumber
methods.description: Returns the API version number of the plugin.

methods.name: getMaskPii_
methods.description: Retrieves and sets the mask PII setting based on current voice status.

methods.name: voiceStatus
methods.description: Queries the current voice status via IARM call.

methods.name: configureVoice
methods.description: Configures voice settings via IARM call.

methods.name: setVoiceInit
methods.description: Initializes voice session parameters via IARM call.

methods.name: sendVoiceMessage
methods.description: Sends a voice message command via IARM call.

methods.name: voiceSessionByText
methods.description: Deprecated method translating text-based voice session requests.

methods.name: voiceSessionTypes
methods.description: Retrieves supported voice session types via IARM call.

methods.name: voiceSessionRequest
methods.description: Starts a voice session with specified parameters via IARM call.

methods.name: voiceSessionTerminate
methods.description: Terminates an active voice session via IARM call.

methods.name: voiceSessionAudioStreamStart
methods.description: Starts audio streaming for a voice session via IARM call.

methods.name: onSessionBegin
methods.description: Handles session begin event and notifies clients.

methods.name: onStreamBegin
methods.description: Handles stream begin event and notifies clients.

methods.name: onKeywordVerification
methods.description: Handles keyword verification event and notifies clients.

methods.name: onServerMessage
methods.description: Handles server message event and notifies clients.

methods.name: onStreamEnd
methods.description: Handles stream end event and notifies clients.

methods.name: onSessionEnd
methods.description: Handles session end event and notifies clients.

methods.name: setApiVersionNumber
methods.description: Sets the internal API version number.

methods.name: sendNotify_
methods.description: Sends notifications, masking PII if configured.
